name: WordPress
description: Open source publishing software that powers a large share of the web.
summary: WordPress broadly allows AI tools for code, tests, documentation and issue drafting, provided contributors understand and test what they submit, can explain it during review, disclose meaningful AI assistance (for example in the PR description or Trac ticket) and keep everything GPLv2-compatible. Low-quality, undisclosed or unverified AI-generated contributions may be closed or rejected.
